projects.name: DomikAuto
projects.desc: Automates and monitors a solar inverter and battery bank, and starts a backup generator on automatic scenarios. Its executing node is DomikAutoSlave.

projects.name: DomikAutoSlave
projects.desc: The executing node of DomikAuto: switches a backup generator over 433 MHz OOK (CC1101) and talks to the master over ESP-NOW. Web dashboard, OTA updates, optional TFT status screen.

projects.name: BrickLights
projects.desc: Lighting for LEGO builds — or anything else. Group addressable LEDs into zones, design per-zone animations, and run automatic scenarios by time or sunrise / sunset.

projects.name: OnAIR
projects.desc: A presence indicator that pairs with MuteDesk: shows people around me whether I'm on a call or can't talk because my mic is live. Tracks call presence through the MuteDesk API.
